title: K. Pidrikson And J. Umblia, Soviet Diplomatic Couriers

page_data.en:
Form No. 3
G. 10000-9-33

SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE.
REPORT

（印：SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL POLICE
C. & F.B.N REGISTRY.
No D_e 5639
SECTION 18 Jan 34
Date 22. 1. 34）

Subject (in full) K. Pidrikson and J. Umblia, Soviet diplomatic couriers.

Made by D.S.I. Prokofiev. Forwarded by A. G. Townsend.

The undermentioned Soviet citizens, who are reported
to be Soviet diplomatic couriers, arrived in Shanghai from the
U.S.S.R. via Japan on January 18, 1934, in the s.s. "Shanghai Maru": -
1. Karl Pidrikson, 45. Holds passport No 2510 issued
on on December 27, 1933, at Moscow.
2. Johann Umblia, 58. Holds passport No 2164 issued on
December 27, 1933, at Moscow.
According to our information they left for Nanking .
shortly after their arrival.

G. Prokofiev
D.S.I.

Officer i/c Special Branch

（批：FILE
JR）
